print_guideline_text:
Print Guidelines
Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

name: Embroidered Two-Tone Canvas Tote Bag
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
- Crafted from durable, high-quality canvas fabric for long-lasting everyday use.
- Features reinforced stitching to enhance durability and keep the shoulder straps securely attached.
- Wide bottom gusset provides extra storage capacity and helps the bag stand upright.
- Soft, comfortable carrying straps designed for hand carrying or shoulder use.
- Washable, reusable, and tear-resistant for daily use.
- Available colors: Green, Red, Navy, Pink, Yellow.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Bag Size: 14.96 × 13.98 inches ~ 38 × 35.5 cm.
- Bottom Gusset Width: 3.34 inches ~ 8.5 cm.
- Embroidery Area: 9.84 × 9.84 inches ~ 25 × 25 cm.
📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be a 1–2 cm variation.
• Embroidery Technology:
- Uses high-quality embroidery technology for clean stitching, textured detail, and long-lasting durability.
- Embroidery is available on both the front and back.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Functional & Usage:
- Designed for everyday carrying, shopping, work, school, travel, or casual outings.
- Spacious interior easily accommodates books, groceries, laptops, and other daily essentials.
- Wide bottom construction increases capacity while maintaining stability.
- Comfortable shoulder straps provide convenient all-day carrying.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, moms, friends, family members, coworkers, or loved ones.
- Perfect for Teacher Appreciation, Mother's Day, birthdays, graduations, Christmas, back-to-school, or other special occasions.
- Custom embroidered design creates a meaningful keepsake while adding a unique personal touch.
- A practical and stylish tote bag for everyday use. 🎁
SPECIFICATION
• Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
• Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
• Packaging: 1x Embroidered Two-Tone Canvas Tote Bag

• Please allow 1-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

name: Fabric Embroidered Patch
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
- Made with a premium fabric base combined with high-quality embroidery stitching for a textured and durable finish.
- Features dense embroidery threads that create a detailed, dimensional appearance with vibrant colors.
- Available in two backing options:
 + Sew-On Patch: Designed to be stitched onto garments or accessories by hand or sewing machine.
 + Iron-On Patch: Equipped with a heat-activated adhesive backing for easy application.
- Custom shape cut to match the design, providing a professional and eye-catching look.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in multiple sizes:
3 × 3 in ~ 9 × 9 cm
4 × 4 in ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
5 × 5 in ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
7 × 7 in ~ 17.78 × 17.78 cm
8 × 8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
9 × 9 in ~ 22.86 × 22.86 cm
📌 Note: The sizes listed are for the largest dimension of the patch. Final measurements depend on the aspect ratio of your design.
• Embroidery Technology:
- Produced using premium embroidery technology with detailed stitching and vibrant thread colors.
- One-sided embroidered design with a textured and dimensional finish.
- Precision-cut custom shapes provide a clean and professional appearance.
- Available in Sew-On and Iron-On options for easy application.
- Durable embroidery maintains its appearance through regular use.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 8 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Care Instructions:
- For Iron-On Patches, wait at least 24 hours after application before washing.
- Turn garments inside out before washing.
- Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.
- Do not use bleach or harsh detergents.
- Air dry whenever possible for maximum longevity.
- Avoid direct ironing on the embroidered surface; place a protective cloth over the patch if ironing is necessary.
- For heavy-use garments, additional stitching is recommended to enhance durability.
• Functional & Usage:
- Perfect for personalizing jackets, hats, backpacks, tote bags, uniforms, jeans, hoodies, and other fabric items.
- Great for showcasing team logos, club emblems, school spirit, military commemorations, sports achievements, brand identities, and custom artwork.
- Helps repair or cover worn areas on clothing while adding a unique decorative element.
- Durable enough for everyday use and long-term display.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- A unique and personalized gift suitable for people of all ages.
- Ideal for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, reunions, team events, holidays, memorials, and special celebrations.
- Great for students, athletes, military veterans, club members, coworkers, friends, and family members.
- Custom designs transform meaningful memories, logos, names, and artwork into lasting keepsakes.

• Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

name: Wooden Bookmark
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Best Material: All bookmarks are hand-made. We hand-select each piece of wood for its unique grain, knots, and natural imperfections which add character. Every bookmark is hand cut, sanded and stained. Bookmarks will not peel, bubble or separate from the wood like vinyl decals or paper overlays often do.
• Perfect Quality and Durability: Design is printed directly to the wood. It is totally BOTH-SIDE printed in modern technology and is covered by superior copperplate paper painting, durable and vivid color. These bookmarks are made with the highest quality materials and the utmost attention to detail, making them gifts to be treasured for many years to come. Designed with a thin layer of flex plastic between the layers to allow for wood flexibility.
• Easy to Customize:Each bookmark is made to order and may vary slightly from our sample photo. We are more than happy to customize and personalize them any way you’d like! You can expect some variance in color, wood grain, and texture. This is what make yours a one-of-a-kind.
• Widely Usage: Bookmarks are ideal decorations choice when you want to hold themed parties or family gathering, to decorate your home, garden, office, yard and other places, let your guests more happier, and have a good time together. Also, bookmark ornaments can be applied for card making, hanging accessories, embellishments, scrapbooking, sign making, home decoration and so on.
• Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends. These make a nice sentimental and personalized gift for you, your loved one, a book club, or even stocking stuffers!
• Easy to use: Comes with a pre-punched hole for attaching accessories or ribbons. 0,12 inches thick – perfect thickness to not crease your pages or bend the spine as other wooden bookmarks do. It can be wiped with a towel containing wax or grease.
SPECIFICATION
• Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly

- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.

📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.

 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Functional & Usage:
- Can be used as a keychain for house keys, car keys, office keys, or bag charms.
- Great for attaching to backpacks, handbags, purses, tote bags, zipper pulls, and pencil cases.
- Lightweight and practical for everyday carrying.
- Helps make keys and accessories easier to identify.

- Great for baby showers, graduation gifts, party favors, and holiday stocking stuffers.

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here.
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

Print Guidelines
• Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products.

• Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
- Made from premium lightweight polyester fabric, soft, durable, and resistant to wear and outdoor conditions.
- Features reinforced edge stitching to help prevent fraying.
- Includes a 12-inch wooden stick handle with a rounded golden safety tip for comfortable handling.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Flag size: 8 x 5.5 inches ~ 20.32 x 13.97 cm
- Wooden handle length: 12 inches ~ 30.48 cm
- Available pack options: Pack 1 - 1 Piece, Pack 2 - 2 Pieces, Pack 5 - 5 Pieces, and Pack 10 - 10 Pieces.
📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design. Size may vary by ±0.25-0.5in, which is considered normal.

- Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight when not in use.

- Great for cheering teams, supporting organizations, promoting events, or decorating homes, offices, classrooms, and outdoor spaces.

name: House Flag
description_text:
FEATURES
• Best material: The garden flag is made of sturdy all-weather polyester, double layer stitching and reinforced corners improve durability. Water & UV resistant material extends the life of this flag and helps maintain its bright colors. Quality craftsmanship goes into every flag which has double sewn edges to prevent fraying.
• Fabric: 100% Polyester
• GSM: Approximately 100g/m2
• Perfect Design:The flag has a sleeve on top that will allow the flag to slide onto a flag stand. Flag stand sold separately. It is truly double-sided printed. The pattern is available in both sides and you don't need to rotate the flag blown back by the wind. Double burlap stitched together greatly enhance the durability of the summer yard flag.
• Widely Usage: Great outdoor decoration for new homeowners, avid gardeners, home decoration and outdoors enthusiasts to display on their patio, porch ,veranda, lawn, garden or backyard.

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

 +) 30 × 25 cm ~ 11.81 × 9.84 in

 +) 18 × 18 cm ~ 7.09 × 7.09 in for the 30 × 25 cm size.

• Embroidery Technology:
- Uses soft chenille yarn to create a thick, raised embroidery effect.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
- Two yarn sizes are available: 2 cm chenille yarn and 7 mm chenille yarn.
- Designs with up to 5 characters can use either yarn size.
- Designs with up to 7 characters are suitable for 7 mm chenille yarn only.
- Best suited for text, initials, simple characters, and clean-line fonts.
- Complex artwork, detailed icons, and overly decorative text are not recommended.
- Embroidery colors must be selected from the provided yarn color chart.
- Actual colors may vary slightly due to lighting, screen settings, and differences between material batches.
• Care Instructions:
To keep your chenille embroidery looking soft, fluffy, and like new:
- Wash the garment inside out in cold water using a gentle cycle.
- Hang dry or tumble dry on low heat.
- Do not iron directly on the chenille embroidery, as high heat may damage or melt the fibers. 
- For best results, iron the garment inside out.
- Do not soak or use bleach.
• Function & Usage:
- Adds personalized texture and dimension to sofas, beds, chairs, and benches.
- Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, nurseries, guest rooms, and offices.
- Envelope closure allows easy insertion and removal of the pillow insert.
- Works well for names, initials, short words, and simple decorative designs.
- Ideal for everyday décor, seasonal styling, and personalized room accents.
- Easy to coordinate with blankets, bedding, and other decorative pillows.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- Perfect for birthdays, housewarmings, weddings, and anniversaries.
- Great for Christmas, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and seasonal celebrations.
- Ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s Day, and baby showers.
- Suitable for personalized family gifts, nursery décor, pet gifts, and memorial keepsakes.

To use an Art Template:

• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

name: Applique Embroidered Hoodie
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
- Made from a soft and durable cotton-polyester blend for warmth and everyday comfort.
- Features a brushed fleece interior, offering added softness and insulation.
- Designed in a US fit, giving a relaxed and easy-to-wear silhouette.
- Ideal for embroidery customization, delivering a premium textured finish that looks clean and long-lasting.
- Available colors: Black, Navy, Forest Green, Sports Grey, Sand, Carolina Blue, Beige, Grey, Military Green, White, Light Pink, Light Blue, Dark Chocolate, Maroon.
- Applique fabric options include Glitter, Striped, and Gingham styles.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in sizes S–5XL.
• Embroidery area:
- Front: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in
- Back: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in
- Left Chest: 12 x 12 cm ~ 4.72 x 4.72 in
- Right Chest: 12 x 12 cm ~ 4.72 x 4.72 in
- Left Sleeve: 6 x 12 cm ~ 2.36 x 4.72 in
- Right Sleeve: 6 x 12 cm ~ 2.36 x 4.72 in
📌NOTE: Applique embroidery is only available on the Front and Back positions. All other position areas will be completed using standard embroidery
• Embroidery Technology:
- Combines fabric appliqué with embroidery stitching for a layered, textured appearance.
- Appliqué embroidery is available only on the front and back positions.
- Chest and sleeve positions use standard embroidery.
- Each appliqué letter or separated design section is limited to one fabric color.
- Multiple appliqué fabric colors within the same letter or continuous section are not supported.
- Suitable for custom names, initials, text, seasonal artwork, and personalized designs.
- Fabric edges are secured with embroidery stitching for a neat and durable finish.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The base price is calculated based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public pricing displayed on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: A mockup upload is required for all applique embroidery products. The factory will use the mockup as the placement reference to ensure the applique embroidery is positioned accurately according to the customer's design and intended layout.
• Functional & Usage:
- Suitable for casual wear, daily outfits, school, work, travel, and outdoor activities.
- Provides comfortable warmth for fall, winter, and cool-weather layering.
- Personalized appliqué details create a distinctive handmade-style look.
- Can feature embroidery on the front, back, chest, or sleeves.
- Easy to pair with jeans, joggers, leggings, and casual footwear.
- Suitable for individuals, couples, families, teams, clubs, and group events.

- Crafted from a 65% cotton - 35% polyester blend, offering a comfortable balance of softness, durability, and easy maintenance.

- Available colors: Black, Navy, Forest Green, Sports Grey, Sand, Carolina Blue, Beige, Grey, Military Green, White, Light Pink, Light Blue, Dark Chocolate, Maroon.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in multiple size options: S - 5XL.
• Embroidery areas:
- Front: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in
- Back: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in

- Right Chest: 12 x 12 cm ~ 4.72 x 4.72 in

• Embroidery Technology:
- Uses high-quality embroidery technology for clean stitching, textured detail, and long-lasting durability.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Functional & Usage:
- Suitable for casual daily wear, school, travel, outdoor activities, team wear, and cooler-weather outfits.
- Easy to pair with jeans, joggers, leggings, shorts, or layered outerwear.
- Great for family matching outfits, club wear, school apparel, holiday gifts, and small business branding.
- Comfortable enough for everyday use while still offering a premium embroidered look.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- A thoughtful gift for friends, family, couples, coworkers, students, and team members.
- Perfect for birthdays, holidays, Christmas, reunions, back-to-school, and personalized keepsakes.
- Ideal for embroidered name hoodies, logo hoodies, matching group apparel, and custom gift items.
- A practical and stylish gift that combines comfort, warmth, and personalization.

name: Applique Embroidered Sweatshirt
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
- Made from a soft and durable cotton-polyester blend for warmth and everyday comfort.
- Ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem help maintain the sweatshirt’s shape.
- Features a brushed fleece interior for added warmth, softness, and everyday comfort.
- Designed in a classic US fit, providing a relaxed and easy-to-wear silhouette for both men and women.
- Available sweatshirt colors: Black, Navy, Forest Green, Sports Grey, Sand, Brown, Carolina Blue, Beige, Grey, White, Light Pink, Military Green, Light Blue, Orange, Dark Chocolate, Maroon.
- Applique fabric options include Glitter, Striped, and Gingham styles.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in sizes S–5XL.
• Embroidery area:
- Front: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in
- Back: 25 x 25 cm ~ 9.84 x 9.84 in
- Left Chest: 12 x 12 cm ~ 4.72 x 4.72 in
- Right Chest: 12 x 12 cm ~ 4.72 x 4.72 in
- Left Sleeve: 6 x 12 cm ~ 2.36 x 4.72 in
- Right Sleeve: 6 x 12 cm ~ 2.36 x 4.72 in
📌NOTE: Applique embroidery is only available on the Front and Back positions. All other position areas will be completed using standard embroidery
• Embroidery Technology:
- Combines fabric appliqué with embroidery stitching for a layered, textured appearance.
- Appliqué embroidery is available only on the front and back positions.
- Chest and sleeve positions use standard embroidery.
- Each appliqué letter or separated design section is limited to one fabric color.
- Multiple appliqué fabric colors within the same letter or continuous section are not supported.
- Suitable for custom names, initials, text, seasonal artwork, and personalized designs.
- Fabric edges are secured with embroidery stitching for a neat and durable finish.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The base price is calculated based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public pricing displayed on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: A mockup upload is required for all applique embroidery products. The factory will use the mockup as the placement reference to ensure the applique embroidery is positioned accurately according to the customer's design and intended layout.
• Functional & Usage:
- Suitable for casual wear, daily outfits, school, work, travel, and outdoor activities.
- Provides comfortable warmth for fall, winter, and cool-weather layering.
- Personalized appliqué details create a distinctive handmade-style look.
- Can feature embroidery on the front, back, chest, or sleeves.
- Easy to pair with jeans, joggers, leggings, and casual footwear.
- Suitable for individuals, couples, families, teams, clubs, and group events.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- Great for couples, families, friends, teachers, coworkers, and team members.
- Ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, anniversaries, graduations, and reunions.

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.

name: AOP Pocket Dress
description_text:
FEATURES
• Best material: You will love our pocket dress once you put them on and experience a perfect combination of softness and stretchiness. Each pocket dress is constructed with a high quality polyester and spandex blend to give you freedom of movement no matter what you’re doing.
• Fabric: 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex
• GSM: Approximately 170g/m2
• Perfect Design: Roll up long sleeves, round neckline, casual pullover style, oversized loose fit, midi knee length, solid color, with pockets at both sides. Oversize loose style, if you want to be more slim, it’s better to fit with a belt on, 2 side pockets can hold your phones, wallet, keys and etc.
• Customization: We make pocket dress on demand, so give us inspired logo you across the front like to create your one-of-a-kind pocket dress. Creative 3D print is suited for outdoor sports, travel, punk rock dressing, walking. Each pocket dress is custom printed, cut and sewn just for you when you place your order – there may be small differences in the design on the seams and/or arms due to the custom nature of the production process! And many colors for choosing: Green, Black, Red, Pink, Grey, Blue.
• Usage: You can mix leggings with denim jeans, pants, leggings, shorts, coat, hats, strappy heels, sneakers, san dals to complete your style and become nice addition for your wardrobe. Perfect for everyday casual use.
• Gift of Love: A meaningful gift for your friends, sister, mother, wife, bridesmaid, girls or loved one on birthday, mother's day, wedding, anniversary, Christmas, engagement, Thanksgiving day, Valentine's day. A wonderful way to honor the memory of a special person or milestone.
• Garment Care: Machine wash or hand wash. Tumble dry on low heat. Avoid direct heat. Do not use bleach.
SPECIFICATION
• Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
• Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
• Packaging: 1x 3D Pocket Dress

• Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.

name: Embroidered Baby Tee
description_text:
KEY FEATURES
• Premium Material:
 - Crafted from 100% cotton, offering a soft, breathable, and comfortable feel for everyday wear.
 - Made with a 250g fabric weight, giving the tee a thicker, more premium feel while maintaining comfort.
- Designed with a neat ribbed collar and reinforced double-needle neckline stitching for improved durability and shape retention.
- Soft-touch cotton fabric helps provide comfort for daily activities, casual styling, and long wear.
- The structured yet comfortable construction makes it suitable for both fashion styling and personalized embroidery.
- Available colors: Black, Navy, Forest Green, Sports Grey, Sand, Beige, White, Light Pink.
• Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in multiple size options: XS - 2XL.
• Embroidery areas:
- Front: 20 x 20 cm ~ 7.87 x 7.87 in
- Back: 20 x 20 cm ~ 7.87 x 7.87 in
- Left Chest: 11 x 11 cm ~ 4.33 x 4.33 in
- Right Chest: 11 x 11 cm ~ 4.33 x 4.33 in
- Left Sleeve: 5.5 x 5.5 cm ~ 2.16 x 2.16 in
 - Right Sleeve: 5.5 x 5.5 cm ~ 2.16 x 2.16 in
• Embroidery Technology:
- Single-sided embroidery with crisp and detailed stitching provides a 3D effect, adding depth and charm to the shirt.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Functional & Usage:
- Functions as both a stylish everyday top and a personalized embroidered fashion item.
- Designed for casual wear, daily outfits, going out, travel, group wear, and personalized wardrobe styling.
- The breathable cotton fabric helps provide comfort throughout the day.
- Suitable for custom personal wear, small business branding, club apparel, event outfits, and gift items.
- Easy to pair with jeans, skirts, shorts, or layered outfits for a simple and fashionable look.
- Perfect for adding a unique and personalized touch to everyday clothing.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
- A thoughtful personalized gift for friends, sisters, daughters, coworkers, partners, and loved ones.
- Perfect for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, graduations, bridesmaid gifts, and special celebrations.
- Ideal for anyone who loves embroidered clothing, minimalist fashion, and personalized apparel.
- Great for casual fashion lovers, custom outfit fans, and meaningful gift giving.
- A stylish gift that combines comfort, quality, and personal expression.
- Adds a cute, fashionable, and memorable touch to any wardrobe 🎁

• Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
• Packaging: 1x Embroidered Baby Tee

description_text:
KEY FEATURES

📌 Note: The sizes listed are for the largest dimension of the patch. Final measurements depend on the aspect ratio of your design.
• Size Recommendations & Usage:
📌 2"–3": Ideal for merit badges and simple designs. Great for caps with 2–3 thread colors. Note: Text may not be very legible at this size.
📌 3"–4": Perfect for shirt pockets, sleeves, and small bags. Be mindful of details and text to avoid a cramped look.
📌 5"–6": Best for chest areas on sports bags, totes, and backpacks.
• Embroidery Style:
- Single-sided embroidery with crisp and detailed stitching.
- Back side features an iron-on adhesive layer, allowing the patch to be applied easily with heat press or iron.
- Provides a secure, long-lasting bond on fabric surfaces.
• 📌 Selling Price:
- This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
- The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
• Design File/Embroidery Notes:
📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
- Designs with text:
 + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
 + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
 + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
- Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 15 different thread colors.
- Avoid designs with:
 + Photographic or gradient-based images,
 + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
- Recommended styles:
 + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
 + Monoline designs.
 + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.
• Functional & Usage:
Perfect for customizing and decorating hats, shirts, jackets, jeans, backpacks, and more. These patches allow you to express your personality, repair garments, or enhance plain items with creative designs.
• Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
A fun, practical, and creative gift for friends, family, or colleagues. Suitable for birthdays, holidays, festivals, and any special occasion where a personalized touch is appreciated.

print_guideline_text:
Print Guidelines
Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
Download templates and mockups here
To use an Art Template:
• Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
• Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
• If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
• Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
• Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
• You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
• Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
To ensure your design prints properly on each product:
• Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
• Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
